name: Come For a Drink
source:
One day while walking home from work, you see that a wushu/chinese martial arts school has opened nearby.  You begin to take lessons there, but soon realize that there's more to the school and its people than meets the eye. 

Are you thirsty? Come for a drink...

[From [url=https://dirchansky.itch.io/come-for-a-drink]itch.io[/url]]
